scene: The lift delivers you to the bustling transit junction in the clouds.
picture: Flat side view of a sky platform. On the far left, a brass-trimmed steam train puffs minty smoke. The girl in the purple wheelchair and teal hoodie sits left of centre. At the centre gate rests a sleek, glowing star shuttle. Moored on the far right floats a striped airship.
shown: a brass-trimmed steam train puffing sweet peppermint smoke on the far left tracks
a sleek star shuttle glowing with neon starlight at the centre gate
a striped airship moored to a wooden mast on the far right
